Lemma
[Analytic reduction for the distance-function bound] ↗ def:weak-laplacian ↗ rem:laplacian-weak-green-identity

The function $x\mapsto d(p,x)$ is $1$-Lipschitz, hence locally Lipschitz. Suppose $(n-1)/d(p,\cdot )$ is locally integrable and that a chosen radial pairing satisfies both the weak Green identity and the polar-coordinate test inequality. Then \[ \triangle d(p,\cdot )\le \frac{n-1}{d(p,\cdot )} \] in the weak sense.
